t.zh: <part-ref to="part:gAnd"></part-ref>：两个输入都为真，才输出真。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:gAnd"></part-ref> outputs true only when both inputs are true.

brief.zh: 接一块电路，算出「下雨，并且不刮风」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Wire a board that works out the value of “it rains and it is not windy” on every row.

hint.en: Two things must hold at once.
